body.acceptance: The four findings the 2026-11-22 review named are resolved on the record: v1-p6-2 (one measured kata), v1-p6-4 (distinct signatures are never suppressed by a card-level count), v1-p6-5 (the four flow producers and the run-less interruptions), v1-p6-6 (the public create path refuses a coach card). Each resolution names a commit and a test in docs/evidence/v1-conformance-findings.json.
obligations: a repeat signature escalates instead of opening a second card
a failed coach run never opens a coach card and a nested coach run is refused
every section 6.2 producer (WIP breach, stale lease, gate timeout, board event, failed run) is observed through one admission path with its own repeat key
a systemic finding opens one kata that names its instrument, measurement and adoption gate
the public create path cannot create a coach card

resolutions.v1-p6-5: apps/server/tests/approval_expire.rs::a_card_scoped_gate_timeout_opens_one_interruption (commit fc020437); lease_sweep; the four card flow producers

body.scope: the coach loop: one card, one triage, one remedy per interruption; per-signature escalation; the depth cap; the depth-2 rule; and the systemic kata path with its instrument, measurement and adoption gate.

title: T4 — delivery contract v2: the remediated coach loop
